### E&F Currency Merge -- GENERATED FILE, DO NOT EDIT
### Rebuild with tools/regen_ef_currency_merge.py after any E&F or hotfix update.
###
### Source: E&F's own common/scripted_effects/09_introduction_building_lvl.txt, three effects taken verbatim with every
### create_building of the central bank replaced by zz_ef_cm_create_owned_bank.
###
### REPLACE_OR_CREATE: is what makes these three override E&F's -- repeating
### the key in a later file does nothing on its own, and the first round of
### this was silently inert for exactly that reason (see the note next to
### OVERRIDE in the generator). They are copied rather than edited by hand
### because macro_facilities_bc alone is 12,000 lines and 1,001 of those call
### sites -- a switch over gdp_view crossed with the country list. All 1,001
### are shaped identically, which is what makes one regex enough.

REPLACE_OR_CREATE:initialize_historic_macro_facilities_bc = { #history
	add_technology_researched = banking
	add_technology_researched = currency_standards
	add_technology_researched = central_banking
	add_technology_researched = metalique_standard

	$CTRL_BANK_SITE$ = {
		zz_ef_cm_create_owned_bank = { BANK_BLDG_TYPE = $BANK_BLDG_TYPE$ CB_SIZE = $CB_SIZE$ }
		owner = {
			add_modifier = {
				name = has_central_bank
			}
			set_variable = {
				name = central_bank_location
				value = $CTRL_BANK_SITE$
			}
		}
	}
	central_bank_modifier = yes
}

REPLACE_OR_CREATE:central_bank_respawn_after_crisis = {
	$CTRL_BANK_SITE$ = {
		zz_ef_cm_create_owned_bank = { BANK_BLDG_TYPE = $BANK_BLDG_TYPE$ CB_SIZE = $CB_SIZE$ }
	}
}
